evidence.title: GitHub - NikunjSonigara/create-next-shadcn-kit: Interactive CLI to create a producation-ready Next.js app with ShadCN UI

name: create-next-shadcn-kit
summary: CLI that scaffolds a Next.js app with shadcn/ui, Tailwind, Redux or Zustand and Husky pre-commit hooks.
description: An interactive CLI that scaffolds a production-ready Next.js app and does the setup in one command: create-next-app (App Router, Tailwind, Turbopack), shadcn/ui init with the components you pick, a Redux Toolkit or Zustand store wired up, and an optional Husky + lint-staged + Prettier pre-commit hook. Flags cover TypeScript/JavaScript, package manager and state library; Node.js 22+ required.
contains: interactive CLI published as create-next-shadcn-kit on npm
scaffolds via create-next-app (App Router, Tailwind, Turbopack), then shadcn init and chosen components
state: Redux Toolkit (default) or Zustand with a sample store wired in
optional Husky + lint-staged + Prettier pre-commit hook
Node.js 22+; works with npm, pnpm, yarn and bun
